  "extractions": [
    {
      "unit": "F000",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The Secretary shall make grants to eligible States for the allotments described in subsections (a) and (b), and shall make payments for the grants in accordance with section 6503(a) of title 31.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["31 U.S.C. 6503(a)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In section 9906, the term “State” does not include Guam, American Samoa, the United States Virgin Islands, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In section 9906",
        "scope_quotes": ["F003"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F014",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Not less than 90 percent of the funds made available to a State under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall be used by the State to make grants for the purposes described in section 9901 of this title to eligible entities.",
        "actor": "the State",
        "actor_quote": "the State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9905", "42 U.S.C. 9906", "42 U.S.C. 9901"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F017",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Funds distributed to eligible entities through grants made in accordance with paragraph (1) for a fiscal year shall be available for obligation during that fiscal year and the succeeding fiscal year, subject to paragraph (3).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "Subject to paragraph (3)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F017"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F021",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Beginning on October 1, 2000, a State may recapture and redistribute funds distributed to an eligible entity through a grant made under paragraph (1) that are unobligated at the end of a fiscal year if such unobligated funds exceed 20 percent of the amount so distributed to such eligible entity for such fiscal year.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "Beginning on October 1, 2000, if unobligated funds at the end of a fiscal year exceed 20 percent of the amount distributed to the eligible entity for that fiscal year",
        "scope_quotes": ["F021"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F023",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with this paragraph, States shall redistribute such funds to an eligible entity, or require the original recipient of the funds to redistribute the funds to a private, nonprofit organization, located within the community served by the original recipient of the funds, for activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.",
        "actor": "States",
        "actor_quote": "States",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with paragraph (3)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F023"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": "The State must either redistribute the funds to an eligible entity, or require the original recipient to redistribute the funds to a private, nonprofit organization located within the community served by the original recipient for activities consistent with the chapter's purposes.",
        "choice_quote": "F023",
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F027:F035",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants under subsection (a), the State shall use the remainder of the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title (subject to paragraph (2)) for activities that may include providing training and technical assistance to entities in need; coordinating State-operated and optional locally-operated programs and services targeted to low-income children and families with services provided by eligible entities and other funded organizations, including detailing appropriate employees to ensure increased access; supporting statewide coordination and communication among eligible entities; analyzing fund distribution to determine targeting to areas of greatest need; supporting asset-building programs for low-income individuals; supporting innovative programs and activities conducted by community action agencies or other neighborhood-based organizations; supporting State charity tax credits as described in subsection (c); and supporting other activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.",
        "actor": "the State",
        "actor_quote": "the State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 to make grants under subsection (a), subject to paragraph (2)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F027"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9905", "42 U.S.C. 9906"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F038",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "No State may spend more than the greater of $55,000, or 5 percent, of the grant received under section 9905 of this title or State allotment received under section 9906 of this title for administrative expenses, including monitoring activities; funds for such expenses shall be taken from the portion of the grant or State allotment remaining after the State makes grants under subsection (a); the cost of activities under paragraph (1)(A) shall not be considered administrative expenses; and the startup cost and cost of administrative activities conducted under subsection (c) shall be considered administrative expenses.",
        "actor": "State",
        "actor_quote": "State",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "No State may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9905", "42 U.S.C. 9906"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F042",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["charity_tax_credit"],
        "statement": "Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit, the State may use for any purpose the amount of the allotment that is available for expenditure under subsection (b).",
        "actor": "the State",
        "actor_quote": "the State",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit",
        "scope_quotes": ["F042"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F045",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["charity_tax_credit"],
        "statement": "The aggregate amount a State may use under paragraph (1) during a fiscal year shall not exceed 100 percent of the revenue loss of the State during the fiscal year that is attributable to the charity tax credit, as determined by the Secretary of the Treasury without regard to any such revenue loss occurring before January 1, 1999.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "During a fiscal year under paragraph (1)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F045"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall not exceed",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F049",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "charity_tax_credit",
        "term_refs": ["qualified_charity"],
        "statement": "The term “charity tax credit” means a nonrefundable credit against State income tax (or, in the case of a State that does not impose an income tax, a comparable benefit) that is allowable for contributions, in cash or in kind, to qualified charities.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In this subsection",
        "scope_quotes": ["F047"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F051:F057",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "qualified_charity",
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The term “qualified charity” means any organization that is described in section 501(c)(3) of title 26 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title, an eligible entity, or a public housing agency as defined in section 1437a(b)(6) of this title; that is certified by the appropriate State authority as meeting the requirements of clauses (iii) and (iv); and if such organization is otherwise required to file a return under section 6033 of title 26, that elects to treat the information required to be furnished by clause (v) as being specified in section 6033(b) of such title.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In this subsection",
        "scope_quotes": ["F047"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["26 U.S.C. 501(c)(3)", "26 U.S.C. 501(a)", "42 U.S.C. 1437a(b)(6)", "26 U.S.C. 6033", "26 U.S.C. 6033(b)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F061",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["collection_organization", "qualified_charity"],
        "statement": "A contribution to a collection organization shall be treated as a contribution to a qualified charity if the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "If the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity",
        "scope_quotes": ["F061"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall be treated",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F062:F065",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "collection_organization",
        "term_refs": ["qualified_charity"],
        "statement": "The term “collection organization” means an organization described in section 501(c)(3) of title 26 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title that solicits and collects gifts and grants that, by agreement, are distributed to qualified charities; that distributes to qualified charities at least 90 percent of the gifts and grants the organization receives that are designated for such qualified charities; and that meets the requirements of clause (vi).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In this subsection",
        "scope_quotes": ["F047"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["26 U.S.C. 501(c)(3)", "26 U.S.C. 501(a)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F069",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "An organization meets the requirements of clause (iii) only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the predominant activity of such organization will be the provision of direct services within the United States to individuals and families whose annual incomes generally do not exceed 185 percent of the poverty line in order to prevent or alleviate poverty among such individuals and families.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "For purposes of certifying a qualified charity under clause (i)(II)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F056"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F071",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "An organization shall not be required to establish or maintain records with respect to the incomes of individuals and families for purposes of subclause (I) if such individuals or families are members of groups that are generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I).",
        "actor": "An organization",
        "actor_quote": "An organization",
        "kind": "exemption",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "scope_text": "If such individuals or families are members of groups generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F071"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall not be required",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F072:F076",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I), services to individuals in the form of donations of food or meals, or temporary shelter to homeless individuals, shall be treated as provided to individuals described in subclause (I) if the location and provision of such services are such that the service provider may reasonably conclude that the beneficiaries of such services are predominantly individuals described in subclause (I).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F072"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall be treated",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F079",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "An organization meets the requirements of clause (iv) only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the annual poverty program expenses of such organization will not be less than 75 percent of the annual aggregate expenses of such organization.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "For purposes of certifying a qualified charity under clause (i)(II)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F056"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F082:F085",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "poverty_program_expense",
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The term “poverty program expense” means any expense in providing direct services referred to in clause (iii), but does not include any management or general expense, any expense for the purpose of influencing legislation (as defined in section 4911(d) of title 26), any expense for the purpose of fundraising, any expense for a legal service provided on behalf of any individual referred to in clause (iii), any expense for providing tuition assistance relating to compulsory school attendance, and any expense that consists of a payment to an affiliate of the organization.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "For purposes of subclause (I)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F080"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["26 U.S.C. 4911(d)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F088:F090",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The information required to be furnished under clause (v) about an organization comprises: (I) the percentages determined by dividing the organization's expenses for direct services, management expenses, general expenses, fundraising expenses, and payments to affiliates by total expenses for the year; and (II) the category or categories (including food, shelter, education, substance abuse prevention or treatment, job training, or other) of services that constitute predominant activities of the organization.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F092:F094",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "A collection organization meets the requirements of clause (vi) if the organization maintains separate accounting for revenues and expenses, and makes available to the public information on the administrative and fundraising costs of the organization, and information as to the organizations receiving funds from the organization and the amount of such funds.",
        "actor": "organization",
        "actor_quote": "organization",
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "For collection organizations under clause (ii)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F065"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F096:F102",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In the case of a State that has a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity and that, as of December 31, 1997, imposed a tax on personal income with a single flat rate applicable to all earned and unearned income (except insofar as any amount is not taxed pursuant to tax forgiveness provisions) and no generally available exemptions or deductions to individuals, the requirement of paragraph (2) shall be treated as met if the amount of the credit described in paragraph (2) is limited to a uniform percentage (but not greater than 25 percent) of State personal income tax liability (determined without regard to credits).",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "statement",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In the case of a State with a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity and meeting specified December 31, 1997 personal income tax conditions",
        "scope_quotes": ["F096:F100"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall be treated",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F105",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2), no part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to pay for the cost of the startup and administrative activities conducted under this subsection.",
        "actor": "State",
        "actor_quote": "State",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": "Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F105"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "no part ... may be used",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F108",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "No part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to provide legal services or to provide tuition assistance related to compulsory education requirements (not including tuition assistance for tutoring, camps, skills development, or other supplemental services or training).",
        "actor": "State",
        "actor_quote": "State",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "No part ... may be used",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F111",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["charity_tax_credit"],
        "statement": "No part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to supplant non-Federal funds that would be available, in the absence of Federal funds, to offset a revenue loss of the State attributable to a charity tax credit.",
        "actor": "State",
        "actor_quote": "State",
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "No part ... may be used",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F121",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall designate, in an application submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b), an appropriate State agency that complies with the requirements of paragraph (2) to act as a lead agency for purposes of carrying out State activities under this chapter.",
        "actor": "The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",
        "actor_quote": "The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "For a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906",
        "scope_quotes": ["F121"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["42 U.S.C. 9905", "42 U.S.C. 9906"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F123:F126",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The lead agency shall develop the State plan to be submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b); in conjunction with the development of the State plan as required under subsection (b), hold at least one hearing in the State with sufficient time and statewide distribution of notice of such hearing, to provide to the public an opportunity to comment on the proposed use and distribution of funds to be provided through the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title for the period covered by the State plan; and conduct reviews of eligible entities under section 9914 of this title.",
        "actor": "The lead agency",
        "actor_quote": "The lead agency",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary shall make grants to eligible States for the allotments described in subsections (a) and (b), and shall make payments for the grants in accordance with section 6503(a) of title 31.
In section 9906, the term “State” does not include Guam, American Samoa, the United States Virgin Islands, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In section 9906

unit_attributes.statement: Not less than 90 percent of the funds made available to a State under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall be used by the State to make grants for the purposes described in section 9901 of this title to eligible entities.

Funds distributed to eligible entities through grants made in accordance with paragraph (1) for a fiscal year shall be available for obligation during that fiscal year and the succeeding fiscal year, subject to paragraph (3).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Subject to paragraph (3)

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning on October 1, 2000, a State may recapture and redistribute funds distributed to an eligible entity through a grant made under paragraph (1) that are unobligated at the end of a fiscal year if such unobligated funds exceed 20 percent of the amount so distributed to such eligible entity for such fiscal year.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning on October 1, 2000, if unobligated funds at the end of a fiscal year exceed 20 percent of the amount distributed to the eligible entity for that fiscal year

unit_attributes.statement: In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with this paragraph, States shall redistribute such funds to an eligible entity, or require the original recipient of the funds to redistribute the funds to a private, nonprofit organization, located within the community served by the original recipient of the funds, for activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In redistributing funds recaptured in accordance with paragraph (3)
unit_attributes.choice_text: The State must either redistribute the funds to an eligible entity, or require the original recipient to redistribute the funds to a private, nonprofit organization located within the community served by the original recipient for activities consistent with the chapter's purposes.

unit_attributes.statement: If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 of this title to make grants under subsection (a), the State shall use the remainder of the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title (subject to paragraph (2)) for activities that may include providing training and technical assistance to entities in need; coordinating State-operated and optional locally-operated programs and services targeted to low-income children and families with services provided by eligible entities and other funded organizations, including detailing appropriate employees to ensure increased access; supporting statewide coordination and communication among eligible entities; analyzing fund distribution to determine targeting to areas of greatest need; supporting asset-building programs for low-income individuals; supporting innovative programs and activities conducted by community action agencies or other neighborhood-based organizations; supporting State charity tax credits as described in subsection (c); and supporting other activities consistent with the purposes of this chapter.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If a State uses less than 100 percent of the grant or allotment received under section 9905 or 9906 to make grants under subsection (a), subject to paragraph (2)

unit_attributes.statement: No State may spend more than the greater of $55,000, or 5 percent, of the grant received under section 9905 of this title or State allotment received under section 9906 of this title for administrative expenses, including monitoring activities; funds for such expenses shall be taken from the portion of the grant or State allotment remaining after the State makes grants under subsection (a); the cost of activities under paragraph (1)(A) shall not be considered administrative expenses; and the startup cost and cost of administrative activities conducted under subsection (c) shall be considered administrative expenses.

Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit, the State may use for any purpose the amount of the allotment that is available for expenditure under subsection (b).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Subject to paragraph (2), if there is in effect under State law a charity tax credit

unit_attributes.statement: The aggregate amount a State may use under paragraph (1) during a fiscal year shall not exceed 100 percent of the revenue loss of the State during the fiscal year that is attributable to the charity tax credit, as determined by the Secretary of the Treasury without regard to any such revenue loss occurring before January 1, 1999.
unit_attributes.scope_text: During a fiscal year under paragraph (1)

unit_attributes.statement: The term “charity tax credit” means a nonrefundable credit against State income tax (or, in the case of a State that does not impose an income tax, a comparable benefit) that is allowable for contributions, in cash or in kind, to qualified charities.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In this subsection

unit_attributes.statement: The term “qualified charity” means any organization that is described in section 501(c)(3) of title 26 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title, an eligible entity, or a public housing agency as defined in section 1437a(b)(6) of this title; that is certified by the appropriate State authority as meeting the requirements of clauses (iii) and (iv); and if such organization is otherwise required to file a return under section 6033 of title 26, that elects to treat the information required to be furnished by clause (v) as being specified in section 6033(b) of such title.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In this subsection

unit_attributes.statement: A contribution to a collection organization shall be treated as a contribution to a qualified charity if the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If the donor designates in writing that the contribution is for the qualified charity

unit_attributes.statement: The term “collection organization” means an organization described in section 501(c)(3) of title 26 and exempt from tax under section 501(a) of such title that solicits and collects gifts and grants that, by agreement, are distributed to qualified charities; that distributes to qualified charities at least 90 percent of the gifts and grants the organization receives that are designated for such qualified charities; and that meets the requirements of clause (vi).
unit_attributes.scope_text: In this subsection

unit_attributes.statement: An organization meets the requirements of clause (iii) only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the predominant activity of such organization will be the provision of direct services within the United States to individuals and families whose annual incomes generally do not exceed 185 percent of the poverty line in order to prevent or alleviate poverty among such individuals and families.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For purposes of certifying a qualified charity under clause (i)(II)

unit_attributes.statement: An organization shall not be required to establish or maintain records with respect to the incomes of individuals and families for purposes of subclause (I) if such individuals or families are members of groups that are generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I).
unit_attributes.scope_text: If such individuals or families are members of groups generally recognized as including substantially only individuals and families described in subclause (I)

unit_attributes.statement: Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I), services to individuals in the form of donations of food or meals, or temporary shelter to homeless individuals, shall be treated as provided to individuals described in subclause (I) if the location and provision of such services are such that the service provider may reasonably conclude that the beneficiaries of such services are predominantly individuals described in subclause (I).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as otherwise provided by the appropriate State authority, for purposes of subclause (I)

unit_attributes.statement: An organization meets the requirements of clause (iv) only if the appropriate State authority reasonably expects that the annual poverty program expenses of such organization will not be less than 75 percent of the annual aggregate expenses of such organization.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For purposes of certifying a qualified charity under clause (i)(II)

unit_attributes.statement: The term “poverty program expense” means any expense in providing direct services referred to in clause (iii), but does not include any management or general expense, any expense for the purpose of influencing legislation (as defined in section 4911(d) of title 26), any expense for the purpose of fundraising, any expense for a legal service provided on behalf of any individual referred to in clause (iii), any expense for providing tuition assistance relating to compulsory school attendance, and any expense that consists of a payment to an affiliate of the organization.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For purposes of subclause (I)

unit_attributes.statement: The information required to be furnished under clause (v) about an organization comprises: (I) the percentages determined by dividing the organization's expenses for direct services, management expenses, general expenses, fundraising expenses, and payments to affiliates by total expenses for the year; and (II) the category or categories (including food, shelter, education, substance abuse prevention or treatment, job training, or other) of services that constitute predominant activities of the organization.

A collection organization meets the requirements of clause (vi) if the organization maintains separate accounting for revenues and expenses, and makes available to the public information on the administrative and fundraising costs of the organization, and information as to the organizations receiving funds from the organization and the amount of such funds.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For collection organizations under clause (ii)

unit_attributes.statement: In the case of a State that has a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity and that, as of December 31, 1997, imposed a tax on personal income with a single flat rate applicable to all earned and unearned income (except insofar as any amount is not taxed pursuant to tax forgiveness provisions) and no generally available exemptions or deductions to individuals, the requirement of paragraph (2) shall be treated as met if the amount of the credit described in paragraph (2) is limited to a uniform percentage (but not greater than 25 percent) of State personal income tax liability (determined without regard to credits).
unit_attributes.scope_text: In the case of a State with a constitutional requirement of tax uniformity and meeting specified December 31, 1997 personal income tax conditions

unit_attributes.statement: Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2), no part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to pay for the cost of the startup and administrative activities conducted under this subsection.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Except to the extent provided in subsection (b)(2)

unit_attributes.statement: No part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to provide legal services or to provide tuition assistance related to compulsory education requirements (not including tuition assistance for tutoring, camps, skills development, or other supplemental services or training).

No part of the aggregate amount a State uses under paragraph (1) may be used to supplant non-Federal funds that would be available, in the absence of Federal funds, to offset a revenue loss of the State attributable to a charity tax credit.

The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title shall designate, in an application submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b), an appropriate State agency that complies with the requirements of paragraph (2) to act as a lead agency for purposes of carrying out State activities under this chapter.
unit_attributes.actor: The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title
unit_attributes.actor_quote: The chief executive officer of a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title
unit_attributes.scope_text: For a State desiring to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906

unit_attributes.statement: The lead agency shall develop the State plan to be submitted to the Secretary under subsection (b); in conjunction with the development of the State plan as required under subsection (b), hold at least one hearing in the State with sufficient time and statewide distribution of notice of such hearing, to provide to the public an opportunity to comment on the proposed use and distribution of funds to be provided through the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title for the period covered by the State plan; and conduct reviews of eligible entities under section 9914 of this title.

In order to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, the State shall hold at least one legislative hearing every 3 years in conjunction with the development of the State plan.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In order to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906

unit_attributes.statement: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title, a State shall prepare and submit to the Secretary an application and State plan covering a period of not less than 1 fiscal year and not more than 2 fiscal years, submitted not later than 30 days prior to the beginning of the first fiscal year covered by the plan, containing such information as the Secretary requires, including the assurances and information set forth in paragraphs (1) through (13).
unit_attributes.scope_text: Beginning with fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906

unit_attributes.statement: For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to a funding reduction, the term “cause” includes a statewide redistribution of funds provided through a community services block grant under this chapter to respond to the results of the most recently available census or other appropriate data, the designation of a new eligible entity, or severe economic dislocation; or the failure of an eligible entity to comply with the terms of an agreement or a State plan, or to meet a State requirement, as described in section 9915(a) of this title.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to a funding reduction

unit_attributes.statement: For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to a termination, the term “cause” includes the failure of an eligible entity to comply with the terms of an agreement or a State plan, or to meet a State requirement, as described in section 9915(a) of this title.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For purposes of making a determination in accordance with subsection (b)(8) with respect to a termination

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary may prescribe procedures for the purpose of assessing the effectiveness of eligible entities in carrying out the purposes of this chapter.
The chief executive officer of each State may revise any plan prepared under this section and shall submit the revised plan to the Secretary.
unit_attributes.actor: The chief executive officer of each State
unit_attributes.actor_quote: The chief executive officer of each State
unit_attributes.scope_text: If revising any plan prepared under this section

unit_attributes.statement: Each plan or revised plan prepared under this section shall be made available for public inspection within the State in such a manner as will facilitate review of, and comment on, the plan.
